title: How Myles Garrett's arrival has the Rams — and even Cooper Kupp — talking Aaron Donald return

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: How Myles Garrett's arrival has the Rams — and even Cooper Kupp — talking Aaron Donald return
sources.description: While wife Erica gently douses rumors, Sean McVay, Les Snead, Cooper Kupp and others hint that Aaron Donald is tempted to unretire and return to the Rams.
